description: Save a screenshot and the probe results of each route, at laptop size (1440 by 900) and then at phone size (390 by 844), in the report folder. Use it right after start_review, before walking the core jobs. Returns, for each route and size, the files saved, the HTTP status and any JavaScript errors. It opens pages on the app's own origin only, 12 routes at most.

routes.description: Paths to capture, such as / and /pricing. A path with a parameter, such as /flows/:id, needs a real id. When left out, it captures the routes the scan found, or / when it found none.

name: capture
